name: whop-apps-sdk
description: Protocol, app SDK, and CLI for the Whop Apps Gateway
author: Michał Nowakowski / Michael Software

scripts.build: npm run build -w @whop-apps-gateway/protocol && npm run build -w @whop-apps-gateway/app-sdk && npm run build -w @whop-apps-gateway/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @whop-apps-gateway/protocol && npm run build -w @whop-apps-gateway/protocol && npm run test -w @whop-apps-gateway/app-sdk && npm run build -w @whop-apps-gateway/app-sdk && npm run test -w @whop-apps-gateway/cli && npm run build -w @whop-apps-gateway/cli
